enchantments.tooltip: Resistance +11: Passive: +11 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Insightful Fortification +76%: +76% Insight bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

Natural Armor +14: Passive: +14 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Lost Purpose: This item is missing some parts that made it unique. Perhaps you can fix that at a Cannith Repurposing Station.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
